_comment: Authoring intents for TEST-PRECON. Map discover fixture_needs[].kind via fixture_kind_map. Phase 4: read-only exploration then author Jira-clean body from body_template + exploration_hints. Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-precon.md.

webbroker_account_setup: Chrome: dealer login URL from corner-platform-map

open_console_session.body_template: Connect to dxCore console on CTQA (e.g. dx run console as ctqa operator).

create_or_select_account.body_template: Create a user with account: use create broker_client (broker CH or BS for .com test platforms), domain default, currency USD. Example placeholders: name=<username>, password=<password>. Create new credentials for the test run; do not reuse the operator login account.

fx_spot_subtype_allowed.body_template: Allow FX_SPOT instruments for the account: corner_subtype set_allowed account=<clearing_code>:<account_code> allowedsubtypes=FX_SPOT. Run help corner_subtype on CTQA to confirm syntax.

account_group_membership.body_template: Add the account to the broker CAG group and a CornerTraderFxConfiguration group (e.g. OPPORTUNITY): use show account_group_hierarchy, locate CAG for broker CH/BS, then update account_group_members key=<group_key> add_accounts=<account_id>.

execution_routing.body_template: Configure ExternalExecution routing for FX_SPOT at account level. Use show profiles domains=ExternalExecution to inspect FIX_AUTO vs ET routing. If ET executor is active for FX_SPOT, unassign FIX_AUTO profile and assign ET per environment policy (FIX_AUTO takes precedence when both apply).

publish_quote.body_template: Publish a realtime quote for the instrument planned for tests (e.g. pub_to_realtime on FX spot suffix for your configuration group). Run help pub_to_realtime on CTQA for the exact instrument string.

webbroker_account_setup.body_template: WebBroker on CTQA: (1) Dealer login at the CTQA WebBroker URL. (2) Create user — Broker code CH or BS, Client Type POA, add to CPG for the broker. (3) Create account — Allowed Instruments FX_SPOT, initial balance, CornerTraderFxConfiguration group (e.g. OPPORTUNITY) aligned with console routing.
